items.title: Astrocade launches $100K contest to vibe code games using AI
items.excerpt: Astrocade is launching a $100,000 winner-take-all creator competition: 25 selected creators spend three weeks building playable content with Astrocade's natural-language, no-code AI game creation tools, and the prize goes to whoever draws the most plays.
items._note: off-list (dexerto); text-to-game platform action, new contest

items.title: Take-Two Addresses AI In GTA 6's Development Again
items.excerpt: In a WSJ tech-conference interview, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said GTA 6 is 'handcrafted' but that the company has been 'in the AI and machine learning business since the beginning of time' and is trying everything to make better games more efficiently.
items._note: off-list; GTA 6 launch week AI stance

items.title: “당연히 ‘카트라이더’인 줄 알았는데…” 게임 AI 복제에 대기업도 ‘발칵’, 무슨 일
items.excerpt: 로블록스에 넥슨 '카트라이더'를 UI·맵·조작감까지 베낀 '드리프트 유니버스'가 올라와 5만명이 몰렸다가 넥슨 요청으로 삭제됐고, 밸브 '레프트 4 데드 2'·'카운터스트라이크 2' 모방작도 등장했다. 업계는 생성형 AI로 원작을 분석해 복제했을 가능성을 제기하며, 개별 게임사의 신고 대응이 한계에 부딪혔다고 본다.
items._note: off-list Korean; distinct from gamemeca Slotbound clone (indie) — this is Nexon/Valve IP on Roblox

items.title: Kimi Launches Game Development Solution With K3.1 Agents Working Inside Unity, Unreal and Blender
items.excerpt: Moonshot AI's Kimi released a game-development solution pairing K3.1 models with Kimi Code and Kimi Work agents that edit Unity, Unreal Engine and Blender projects directly, demonstrating a 20-hour unattended run that turns a concept into a functional prototype.

items.title: テンセント、ゲーム開発に強い新AI『Hy4』発表　Unityなどでマルチプレイの実装を支援
items.excerpt: Tencent's new Hy4 LLM was trained with input from its games division to implement multiplayer game logic and track game state, tuned for Unreal Engine, Unity and Godot; Tencent reports +19.1% on GameDev and +9.8% on GameLogic benchmarks vs the preview, and showcased a 3D driving sim built with it.
items._note: off-list Japanese; game-engine angle of a general model release

items.title: Overwolf’s Nitro & Base44 Launch $65K Contest for Web Games Built with AI
items.excerpt: Overwolf's Nitro and prompt-to-app builder Base44 opened a $65,000 contest (Nov 5 - Dec 3) for playable browser games built from natural-language prompts in Base44; winners get featured in the Overwolf App Store.
items._note: off-list press release; pairs with Astrocade contest — curator pick at most one

items.title: AMD FSR4 is Now Available on Xbox Series X/S and Asus ROG Xbox Ally and Ally X Through Microsoft GDK
items.excerpt: Microsoft made AMD's machine-learning-based FSR 4 upscaling available to developers on Xbox Series X|S and ROG Xbox Ally handhelds via the GDK, after working with AMD to run the ML upscaler on RDNA 2 hardware, ahead of GTA 6.
items._note: on-list; AI = ML upscaling (weaker); pcgamer duplicate exists

items.title: ゲーム制作にかかる時間は30分で模倣作も次々登場､生成AIが変える開発現場と｢アイデアを先に出したら負ける｣時代
items.excerpt: Feature on how generative AI is reshaping Japanese game development: Yuji Horii's new title and '80億分の1' were made in very short time, 30-minute game builds and rapid copycats raise copying and copyright problems — an era where 'showing your idea first means losing'.

items.title: AI 게임 개발사 앵커노드, 日 명작 리메이크 직접 맡는다
items.excerpt: AI 게임 아트 생성 솔루션 기업 앵커노드가 대원미디어와 일본 고전 게임 IP 리메이크 계약을 맺고 개발에 착수했다. AI 에셋 생성 기술을 실제 IP 게임 제작에 적용하는 첫 협력 사례다.

items.title: Nintendo's Mario creator Miyamoto sees 'things we can do' even in AI era
items.excerpt: Shigeru Miyamoto said that as AI becomes more capable of handling game development work, it will 'create opportunities for everyone to think seriously about what creation really means.'
items._note: off-list paywalled; same genre as Kojima pick — use only if Kojima dropped
